_game: COOM: Run and Gun (Doom continual-RL suite; own scenario, not stock ViZDoom)
_note: Needs TTomilin/COOM cloned into external/coom at the commit the README pins (README 'External checkouts') -- the coom backend reads its conf.cfg/.wad scenario assets directly, it does not pip install the COOM package (which pins a conflicting gymnasium version). env_kwargs.task picks a WAD variant (default 'default'; also 'blue'/'red'/'green'/'hard'/'monsters'/'obstacles'/'resized'/'shadows').
_keys_note: COOM's Discrete(12) action table (turn x move x execute): 0=noop, 1=execute, 2=forward, 3=forward+execute, 4=turn right, 6=turn right+forward, 8=turn left, 10=turn left+forward. For run_and_gun the 4th ('execute') button is ATTACK, on SPACE below; the no-key entry is "": 0. Keep the instructions' Controls text in sync with 'keys' by hand.

instructions.title: Run and Gun
text: Locate and shoot the enemies scattered around
the maze. You have unlimited ammunition.
